_: Idea #20 in-world skill tree — Phase 0 (JContainers JFormDB persistence, design §七 Phase 0). A trainer NPC whose 'Train your Endurance' dialogue line PERSISTS per-NPC skill state to a JFormDB storage keyed on the speaker, then SYNCS the matching perk from the stored rank. No Campfire / in-world UI — this is the pure-effect persistence layer ('an NPC grows perks from stored state'). ⚠ REQUIRES JContainers SE installed at runtime, and compiling the generated TIF_*.psc needs JContainers' own .psc on the Papyrus header path (main machine; see WAIT_USER). Lifecycle note: only the root-DB path API (JFormDB.solveXxxSetter/solveInt) is used, so there is no JValue.object()/retain()/release() to balance (design unknown U5 — avoided by construction). The perk here is a trivial inline PERK so the spec is self-contained; swap to your real skill-tree perks.

perks.name: Adaptation
perks.description: Endurance node — the bearer endures and hits a touch harder.
perks._effect: A trivial self-contained entryPoint so the perk does something when synced; swap for your real node effect.

npcs.name: Skill Trainer
npcs._: A plain NPC to host the trainer dialogue. Place/spawn it however you like; the skill state hangs on this NPC's Form via JFormDB.

quests.name: Skill Training
quests._: StartGameEnabled controller quest so the dialogue is loaded/evaluated. type=None keeps it out of the journal.

dialogue._: On pick: bump the speaker's stored Endurance level + ratio (delta = read-add-write counters), set the Adaptation node rank to 2, then sync perks — Adaptation is added once its stored rank reaches 2.
